A measurement reference for shoes, hoodies and jackets

Keep body measurements, seller-chart values and warehouse measurements in separate fields. Use centimetres consistently and record how each value was taken. A flat garment width is not automatically a body circumference, and an outsole length is not a recommended foot length.

CategoryCompare these fieldsResolve before ordering
ShoesFoot length, width needs, seller size label and the chart's stated methodWhether the chart describes feet, insoles or outsoles
HoodiesFlat chest width, body length, shoulder and sleeve measurementWhether shoulder seams are regular or dropped and whether a set includes trousers
JacketsChest, shoulder, sleeve and back length with intended layersClosure position, lining thickness and the room needed over clothing

For a practical shortlist, continue with the shoe comparison guide, hoodie measurement guide or jacket fit guide. Save a screenshot of the selected listing's chart and the order option together. If an important field is absent or ambiguous, obtain that information before committing to a size. No universal OOPBUY size chart can replace the measurements for the exact item.
